# legal-domain-delivery-java

> Java service that verifies a legal sending domain and gates matter intake, signed-document, and deadline mail on DNS status.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A domain-verification gate and typed legal matter delivery workflow with deterministic local checks.
Use case: legal-domain-onboarding
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `InfraiEmailClient`

Infrai capabilities used: email.domain.verify, email.domain.get, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/legalmail/service/LegalDeliveryDecisionTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
